//_about: Reference config.json — every top-level field, with the built-in default values. Copy to ~/.claude/plugins/creditgauge/config.json (or $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/plugins/creditgauge/config.json) and edit. This file is valid JSON on purpose: '//_'-prefixed KEYS carry the annotations, so it parses as-is. Full guide: MANUAL.md §2.
//_precedence:
defaults ⊕ this file (top-level) ⊕ providers.

.config — provider config is highest. A bad field warns on stderr and falls back to its default; it never takes the whole file down.
//_display_comment: "used" | "remaining". Picks which end of the quota window the bar and percentage show. Default: "remaining".
//_modeLabels_comment: Line prefix, chosen by provider TYPE (QUOTA → used/remaining, BALANCE → balance).
//_labels_comment: Prefix for each token-stat axis, shared by the per-turn / m_acc* / m_sum* families of that axis. Values are used verbatim (include your own trailing colon/space). Omit any field to keep its default.
//_colors_comment: A symbolic shortcut (brightBlack / brightGreen / darkGreen / yellow / orange / red) OR a literal ANSI SGR matching ^\x1b\[[0-9;]*m$. NOTE: 'broken' has no shortcut — its default is plain red, not 'red' (which is bright red). Newlines are rejected.
//_cacheHitColors_comment: 3-band palette for m_tokenHitRate: >= cacheHitThresholds[1] → good, >= [0] → warn, else bad.
//_thresholds_comment: percentBands: 5-band cutoffs for percentage rendering. balanceBands: the same for DeepSeek's absolute balance (not %). Each must be exactly 4 ascending numbers.
//_stale_comment: Glyphs for the m_age annotation: 'healthy' when the chain is fresh, 'broken' when the fetch failed and a cached value is being shown.
//_timeFormat_comment: Governs ALL time rendering (reset countdown, stale suffix). minUnit is the smallest unit shown — units below it collapse to "<1<minUnit>". maxUnitCount (clamped [1,4]) is how many non-zero units to keep: 2h3m4s → "2h3m".
//_countdown_comment: Reset-countdown glyphs, indexed by remainingMs / resetDurationMs so the array reads left-to-right as "few remaining → many remaining". Two glyphs reproduce the v0.2.1 hourglass pair; one glyph is static. Providers without start data (DeepSeek, legacy) fall back to index 0.
//_autoSpace_comment: prefixSpace prepends a space before each module; suffixSpace appends one before a following module. An explicit |prefix:| / |suffix:| on a token wins over these.
//_tokenFormat_comment: Compact-number and precision knobs for the m_token* family. thresholds is [lo, hi]: < lo renders raw, < hi renders k, above renders M. cacheHitThresholds is [lo, hi] for the 3-band cache-hit palette. speedScaleBands maps tokens/s to the 5-band speed scale (4 ascending cutoffs per direction; 'in' bands are 5x 'out' because input streams run hotter).
//_lineTemplates_comment: Registry of reusable token-array fragments, read by m_template's first argument. Allowed tokens: any m_* module EXCEPT m_template, plus s_* separators. Keys are yours to choose — colliding with a shipped fragment warns and is skipped. Shipped keys: quota, balance, model_info, context_info, plugin_info, mem_info, git_info, quote. NOTE: every key here is a fragment name, so a '//_'-prefixed comment key would be read as one and warn — annotations for this block must live outside it.
//_statuslineTemplate_comment: The template actually rendered: a string[] of tokens, or a string naming a preset (simple / compact / solo / standard). Default is the array below — it routes by provider TYPE through the shipped quota/balance fragments.
//_tokenPrices_comment: Token pricing lives in config.tokenPrices.json (a sibling of this file), NOT here — see config.tokenPrices.example.json for the provider→model hierarchy and the 5-layer resolution cascade.
//_quoteInsecureTls_comment: Pass --insecure / -k to curl for m_quote address-mode fetches. Opt in only for self-signed / untrusted-CA HTTPS endpoints.
//_debug_comment: Per-subkey diagnostics, AND-gated with CREDITGAUGE_DIAGNOSTICS_ENABLE=1. Valid subkeys: stdin, statusStore, config, cache, statCache, smokeNormalizeTick, pluginVersion, parse. Truthy strings ("1"/"true"/"yes") or boolean true; unknown keys are dropped.
//_providerOverride_comment: Force one provider instead of matching ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL. Must name a key in `providers` that also has a plugin on disk, else it warns and falls back to matching. Use it for local proxies that share a host and differ only by an arbitrary port. Empty = no override.
//_providers_comment: Registry of providers. TYPE and COMPARE_METHOD are case-sensitive and must be uppercase — a wrong-case value drops the whole entry. COMPARE_METHOD: EXACT | INCLUDE (substring) | STARTWITH (prefix + suffix-attack guard). An entry overriding a built-in id (minimax, deepseek) inherits the fields it omits.

minimax.//_config_comment: Optional per-provider overrides of any top-level key EXCEPT `providers` (no recursion) and `providerOverride` (self-referential). tokenPrices set here has the highest priority — levels 1 and 3 of the 5-layer cascade.
